<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary agenda:</strong> Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has hinted at reconvening Parliament, with the long-awaited delimitation bill expected to be a primary focus.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral dynamics:</strong> The BJP faces significant strategic concerns in Uttar Pradesh ahead of upcoming elections, with analysts pointing to the &quot;Gen X&quot; factor as a greater challenge than the youth vote.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition leadership:</strong> Tamil Nadu minister P. Viswanathan has publicly endorsed Rahul Gandhi as the INDIA bloc’s prime ministerial candidate for the 2029 general elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Regional governance and conflict:</strong> The TMC has accused the BJP of political vendetta following the filing of FIRs and arrests of party leaders in Kolkata, while the Congress has refused to join the National Conference cabinet in J&amp;K until statehood is restored.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>International trade:</strong> The Indian Cabinet has approved the export of 25,000 metric tonnes of DAP fertiliser to Nepal to support the neighboring nation&#x27;s agricultural needs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
